system.description: You begin to exert chakra into an oppressive aura around yourself with enough intensity to be seen by the naked eye and even move loose materials such as dirt, leaves, and water droplets. Creatures who are within 10 feet of you upon activation of this jutsu must make a Strength saving throw to not be pushed to their knees and become Prone for the duration, becoming unable to stand while inside the aura. Creatures knocked Prone by this jutsu remakes their saving throw at the beginning of their turn to end the effect. If you, or an affected creature moves outside of the aura, the jutsu’s effect ends on them immediately. A creature affected by this jutsu, who ends or escapes its effects, cannot be affected again until the end of their next turn.
